params.comment: Git Crafter ships the Process and Metrics pages, built into pages/dist before the Quality collect (pages.yml build job). Its styles are pages/site.css and the template's quality/render/page.css, on the tokens in quality/render/tokens.css. The token files define the colors, so they are left out of the raw scans. Off-scale type and off-token color need a JSON or YAML token file, which Git Crafter does not keep, so both are off Git Crafter's score, as is usability.unlabeled_fields: its pages have no form. usability.form_page_kib stays, unread, as the tab's only consumption metric.

raw_scan_exempt.why: the token file that defines every color

params.comment: The crawl reads pages/dist before the Quality page is built into pages/dist/quality, so /quality/ is skipped: its link from the Process pages is a measurement artifact, not a broken link.
